description:
We are Ares Base Guardians a passionate, multidisciplinary team driven by space exploration, inclusive education, and open science. Our team combines system engineering, AI data integration, and creative pedagogical design to build immersive tools that bridge complex aerospace challenges with young learners.

Our Project: Mission Sol-4: Ares Base Guardians: We developed "Mission Sol-4", a 100% front-end, zero-login educational web game designed for children and educators.
